content: What is your biggest frustration when using new software?

The biggest challenge in my daily routine is dealing with fragmented tools and slow, repetitive manual tasks. When software is clunky or unintuitive, it takes away valuable time from high-impact work.
What is your current job and daily workflow?
I am a Senior Marketing Manager. In my daily work, I focus on executing projects, coordinating with stakeholders, and finding ways to make our workflows more efficient.
